title: 映清斋 Yingqing Zhai
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.54 m, eave 3.64 m, ridge 6.11 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映清斋、鉴园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
evidence.summary: South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.

evidence.title: 御製 映清齋
evidence.excerpt_zh:
映清齋
迴廊彎似弓齋閣據當中三面全臨水八窻迥俯空近遥相（去聲）一合上下影相（平聲）同心境於何覔光光映鏡銅
evidence.summary: Form of the building: a gallery bent like a bow with the study at its centre, water on three sides and eight windows.

evidence.title: 御製 映清齋
evidence.excerpt_zh:
映清齋
弓様廻廊扇様齋溶溶池水緑侵階憑軒不必五絃撫一曲薫風早入懷
evidence.summary: Repeats the form: a bow-shaped gallery, a fan-shaped study, and green water up to the step.

evidence.title: 映清斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.24, under 映清斋; source ref 9-204
evidence.excerpt_zh: 宛转回廊圆中规，纱疏面面俯临池。春风淡荡吹澜候，秋月高寒入影时。澄际堪因悟心性，照来恰复见须眉。如斯无尽藏佳处，久坐何曾刻漏移。
evidence.summary: Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

evidence.title: 映清斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.26, under 映清斋; source ref 9-221
evidence.excerpt_zh: 回廊半浸水，水气入斋凉。互映色空际，含清上下光。契神于缥渺，得景即苍茫。物色与人意，相将报白藏。
evidence.summary: Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

evidence.title: 昭旷亭
evidence.locator: v4 p.25, under 映清斋; source ref 9-205
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四柱虚亭不设棂，天容寥廓水清泠。适然俯仰得佳会，回绝寻常色与形。
evidence.summary: Poem 昭旷亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

evidence.title: 映清斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.27, under 映清斋; source ref 9-342
evidence.excerpt_zh: 弓样游廊月样窗，一时清趣果无双。即声即色契真净，犹觉多言者个摐。
evidence.summary: Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 映清斋
evidence.summary: A water garden of 1766 south of 玉玲珑馆: a fan-shaped nine-bay study with water on three sides and curved galleries, 月香水影 an open hall, the five-bay two-storey 晴望楼, 益思堂, 陶嘉书屋, 豁如室 and the double-eaved square 昭旷亭.

evidence.title: 海岳开襟; 映清斋; 蒨园; 鉴园; 狮子林 (search-index text)
evidence.summary: 海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.
